comparison.objective: Transport an already-threaded opaque collar along a curved protected guide; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record emphasizes occlusion-aware collision-free transport through changing guide orientation. Candidate emphasizes hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar adjustment and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires threading, target support, release, stillness and no prohibited contact, but its referenced complete numeric rubric is absent and it has no indexed spec versions. Candidate requires non-bottoming repeated stops and retained setting, with some thresholds also undeclared.
comparison.reason: The available complete body clearly establishes constrained transport rather than mechanical tuning; missing numeric rubric details do not plausibly create an objective duplicate.
